title: openIn
description: Ask the shell to open a different app in this frame's cluster with an optional payload.
signature: openIn(appId: string, payload?: unknown): Promise<{ instanceId: string }>
errors: KaavaRpcError if the app cannot be opened or is running under a standalone Tauri host
semantics: Routes through the shell to find or create an app instance in the same cluster; rejected under Tauri host.
